t: Caliph Al-Maamun and the Pyramids of Egypt

s: It is told that the Caliph Al–Maamun, son of Harun al-Rashid, when he entered the God-guarded city of Cairo, was minded to pull down the Pyramids, that he might take what was therein; but, when he went about to do this, he could not succeed, albeit his best was done.
He expended a mint of money in the attempt,—And Shahrazad perceived the dawn of day and ceased to say her permitted say.
